#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

aws logs tail "{{log_group}}" \
  --follow \
  --since 5m \
  --format short \
  --filter-pattern '{{filter_pattern}}' \
  | while IFS= read -r line; do
      if echo "$line" | grep -qiE 'error|exception|fail'; then
        printf "\x1b[31m%s\x1b[0m\n" "$line"
      else
        echo "$line"
      fi
    done
